title: Speaking now / Up next
slide_intent: Apply the same hierarchy to a live event so attendees can distinguish the current speaker from the next one.
strategic_value: Channel 4’s adjacent-world idea can connect internal presentation materials to its broadcast identity.
demonstration: A presentation screen pairs Speaking now / Emily Todd above Up next / Faizan Sherman, with a small leading 4 and two horizontal gradient regions.
practical_value: Separate current and upcoming information with spatial hierarchy rather than adding unrelated graphic devices.

content_islands.name: Current speaker
content_islands.spec: Place the larger upper gradient region behind the current speaker information and leading mark.

content_islands.name: Next speaker
content_islands.spec: Reserve the shallower lower region for the upcoming speaker.

reference_purposes.Application: The gradient-panel system is applied to current and next speakers in a presentation.
